title: NIST Dictionary of Algorithms and Data Structures: adaptkdtree
text:
adaptive k-d tree
adaptive k-d tree
(data structure)
Definition:
A
tree
for multidimensional points where successive levels may be split along different dimensions.
See also
k-d tree
.
Note:
After
[GG98]
.
